# 6sqft

> > New York City real estate, architecture, and design publication covering luxury condos, rentals, interior design, and urban development.

6sqft is a comprehensive NYC real estate and design resource featuring coverage of high-end residential developments, architectural projects, amenity design, and the work of notable architects like Rafael Viñoly and firms like MAWD, Related Companies, and Roger Ferris + Partners across neighborhoods from Financial District to Williamsburg.

## Key Topics

- NYC real estate
- Luxury condos
- Rafael Viñoly
- MAWD
- The Greenwich
- Amenity design
- Interior design
- Waterfront development
- Williamsburg
- Financial District
- Tribeca
- High-rise residential
- Rental buildings
- Washington Heights
- Related Companies

## Luxury Residential Developments

- [MAWD](https://www.6sqft.com/biz/mawd/): MAWD designs luxury amenities for Rafael Viñoly's Greenwich in NYC

## NYC Rental Properties

- [Level BK](https://www.6sqft.com/establishment/level-bk/): Level BK rental building in Williamsburg with free rent deals

## Hospitality & Hotels

- [Uptown Hotels](https://www.6sqft.com/place/uptown-hotels/): New hotel developments in Washington Heights opening summer

## Design & Innovation

- [Salone Del Mobile](https://www.6sqft.com/event/salone-del-mobile/): Cork Helmet noise-blocking design at Salone Del Mobile
- [Carbon Fiber](https://www.6sqft.com/product/carbon-fiber/): Matthew Strong's carbon fiber Eames sofa design
- [Ceramics](https://www.6sqft.com/product/ceramics/): Olivier Van Herpt's functional 3D printed ceramics
